chart.title: Prazo
chart.expression: SELECT PRAZO, COUNT(*) AS QTREQUISICAO FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TRUNC(NVL(MAX(CAP.DTENTSAI), :PERIODO.FIN)) - TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) AS DIAS, NVL(:DIASPRAZO, 7) AS DIASPRAZO, CASE WHEN TRUNC(NVL(MAX(CAP.DTENTSAI), :PERIODO.FIN)) - TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) <= NVL(:DIASPRAZO, 7) THEN 'No Prazo' ELSE 'Fora do Prazo' END AS PRAZO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR ITA ON ITA.NUNOTAORIG = ITC.NUNOTA AND ITA.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITV.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAP ON ITA.NUNOTA = CAP.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (400, 401) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) ) GROUP BY PRAZO

chart.title: Status
chart.expression: SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS QTREQUISICAO FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CASE WHEN MAX(CAP.NUNOTA) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Fechado' WHEN MAX(ITC.NUNOTA) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Em andamento' ELSE 'Aberto' END AS STATUS FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR ITA ON ITA.NUNOTAORIG = ITC.NUNOTA AND ITA.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITV.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAP ON ITA.NUNOTA = CAP.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (400, 401) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA ) GROUP BY STATUS

grid.title: Detalhamento de Requisicoes
grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CAB.DTNEG, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, MIN(TRUNC(NVL(ITC.DTNEG, ITC.DTENTSAI))) AS DTINICIOCOTACAO, MAX(TRUNC(CAP.DTENTSAI)) AS DTATENDIMENTO, TRUNC(:PERIODO.FIN) AS DTCORTE, TRUNC(NVL(MAX(CAP.DTENTSAI), :PERIODO.FIN)) - TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) AS DIAS, NVL(:DIASPRAZO, 7) AS PRAZOLIMITE, CASE WHEN MAX(CAP.NUNOTA) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Fechado' WHEN MAX(ITC.NUNOTA) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Em andamento' ELSE 'Aberto' END AS STATUS, CASE WHEN TRUNC(NVL(MAX(CAP.DTENTSAI), :PERIODO.FIN)) - TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) <= NVL(:DIASPRAZO, 7) THEN 'No Prazo' ELSE 'Fora do Prazo' END AS PRAZO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR ITA ON ITA.NUNOTAORIG = ITC.NUNOTA AND ITA.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITV.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAP ON ITA.NUNOTA = CAP.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (400, 401) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CAB.DTNEG, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) ORDER BY CAB.DTNEG, CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CAB.DTNEG, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, TRUNC(NVL(MAX(CAP.DTENTSAI), :PERIODO.FIN)) - TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) AS DIAS, CASE WHEN TRUNC(NVL(MAX(CAP.DTENTSAI), :PERIODO.FIN)) - TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) <= NVL(:DIASPRAZO, 7) THEN 'No Prazo' ELSE 'Fora do Prazo' END AS PRAZO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR ITA ON ITA.NUNOTAORIG = ITC.NUNOTA AND ITA.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITV.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAP ON ITA.NUNOTA = CAP.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (400, 401) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CAB.DTNEG, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) ) WHERE PRAZO = :PRAZO ORDER BY DTNEG, NUNOTA, SEQUENCIA

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CAB.DTNEG, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, TRUNC(NVL(MAX(CAP.DTENTSAI), :PERIODO.FIN)) - TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) AS DIAS, CASE WHEN MAX(CAP.NUNOTA) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Fechado' WHEN MAX(ITC.NUNOTA) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Em andamento' ELSE 'Aberto' END AS STATUS FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR ITA ON ITA.NUNOTAORIG = ITC.NUNOTA AND ITA.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITV.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAP ON ITA.NUNOTA = CAP.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (400, 401) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CAB.DTNEG, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, TRUNC(NVL(CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.DTNEG)) ) WHERE STATUS = :STATUS ORDER BY DTNEG, NUNOTA, SEQUENCIA
